paragraphs.title: Passion & Origins
paragraphs.text: I'm Eren, a software developer with a deep interest in computers and engineering since childhood. My journey began in high school, mastering object-oriented concepts and discovering low-level software architecture.

paragraphs.title: Growth & Specialization
paragraphs.text: Starting as a freelancer, I quickly transitioned to a full-time software developer role. Over the years, I specialized in high-throughput backend APIs and native iOS development using Swift.

paragraphs.title: Enterprise Impact & Launches
paragraphs.text: I engineered end-to-end secure file transfer systems for Teknosa and TEMSA. Furthermore, I built App Store production apps, BI analytics dashboards, and mobile paywall monetization engines.
